welcome.ask.p: Answers are grounded in the forest and arrive with their sources — nodes you can open, read and correct.
welcome.ask.title: Ask it
welcome.connect.p: Claude Code or any MCP agent plugs into this Station and gains the forest's tools: recall, navigation, SQL, planting.
welcome.connect.title: Connect an AI
welcome.feed.p: Upload documents, adopt whole folders, clip pages from your browser. The Gardener turns them into curated, findable knowledge.
welcome.feed.title: Feed it
welcome.p1: MonkeyLLM keeps a knowledge forest: curated markdown nodes an AI can navigate, question and extend. This Studio is how people watch, govern and teach it — but the forest is built to be read and fed by your own agents, over MCP, for as long as you keep it growing.
welcome.sub: The console is a window. The forest behind it is the product.
welcome.title: A brain your AIs can grow
